title: Oceanic Spicy Dutch Seafood Pilaf
description: A spicy and pillowy Dutch dish featuring seafood stock and char-grilled flavors, perfect for a brunch mood, this recipe is jain-friendly and serves as a great option for those looking for a flavorful and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: mixed seafood
ingredients.notes: such as shrimp, mussels, and scallops

instructions: Heat the seafood stock in a large saucepan over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the basmati rice to the saucepan and cook according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat some oil over medium-high heat and saute the mixed seafood until it is cooked through.
Add the char-grilled bell peppers, onion, and garlic to the pan and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the garam masala, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in the cooked seafood and vegetable mixture.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the pilaf and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro, if desired.
